sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies

2. Use 'Long Combo' strategies, which involve creating combos that last for several turns, earning you extra points and bonuses.

3. Experiment with 'Power-Up' combinations, which involve using power-ups in creative ways to earn rewards and bonuses.

4. Use 'Tile Blocking' strategies, which involve blocking tiles that are in the way of your combo, allowing you to clear the board more efficiently.
